title: SR 11-7 — Guidance on Model Risk Management
description: US Federal Reserve/OCC supervisory guidance on model risk management, widely cited outside banking as a general model-risk-management reference. Community confidence: this record relies on well-established background knowledge of SR 11-7 rather than a fresh, dedicated verification pass in this research round — a maintainer should confirm current text and applicability before treating this as Verified.
framework_name: SR 11-7 / OCC Bulletin 2011-12 — Guidance on Model Risk Management
control_text: Establishes supervisory expectations for identifying, managing, and monitoring model risk across a model's lifecycle, including independent validation, ongoing performance monitoring against expected outcomes, and defined escalation when a model's actual performance diverges materially from its expected performance.
